title: Work-tape cell update rule
statement: For a finite-tape Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input symbols, an optional state $q$, read data $\rho$, a work tape $h$, an integer cell offset $d$, and tape contents $f:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, define the updated cell symbol as follows. If $q$ is absent, use $f(d)$. If $q$ is present, let the transition's movement on tape $h$ be $m$ and its write instruction be $w$: when $d+m=0$, use the write instruction applied to the symbol read on tape $h$; otherwise use $f(d+m)$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-tape Turing machine M with Boolean input symbols
